answer: At dawn a sybil operator spins up fresh masks, but they rarely wander far from home: their capital flows and invite edges trace back to one common, umber-dark pool of shared sources. The economy builds a funding-path graph, and when many identities converge on a single origin it treats that cluster as one actor and caps its combined reward accrual. So every new mask must be independently sourced and aged — attacker cost scales linearly per fake instead of amortizing across the swarm.
